meta.title: Open Safety Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Open Safety Studio: free software for construction safety plans. Health and safety plan, BLVC plan, risk matrix and safe maintenance, with templates per sector and the legal basis alongside.

header.label: In development · Construction safety
header.title: Open Safety Studio
header.tagline: Health and safety plan, BLVC plan and risks in one app
header.desc: Draw up a health and safety (V&G) plan, a BLVC plan, a risk matrix or a safe maintenance plan, always with the relevant legal article alongside. Start from a template for your type of project, with risks and measures ready to go, and turn it into a report.
header.feedbackBtn: Share an idea or report a problem

alt.matrix: The risk matrix with probability and severity and the risks of a project
alt.annex: The health and safety plan with the special risks from Annex II and the legal basis alongside
alt.blvc: The BLVC plan with accessibility, liveability, safety and communication
alt.maintenance: Safe maintenance with the building information and the legal basis

notice.text: In development: you can try Open Safety Studio in the browser, but saving and reopening projects is not possible yet. Always check a plan yourself before you use it.

features.label: Features
features.heading: From risk to plan
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

matrix.title: See which risk needs attention first
matrix.desc: Rate every risk on probability and severity in a five-by-five matrix. The score sets the level, from very low to very high, and the colour in the matrix shows at once where the problems are. For each risk you record the measures, each with a person responsible.

vg.title: Everything Article 2.28 asks for, in one place
vg.desc: Project details, parties involved, phases, the special risks from Annex II, asbestos, hazardous substances, emergency procedures and the worksite arrangement. The sidebar shows what the Dutch Working Conditions Decree (Arbobesluit) requires and when a health and safety plan is mandatory.

blvc.title: The building site and its surroundings
blvc.desc: Record per phase how the area stays accessible, how you limit nuisance, how passers-by stay safe and how you inform local residents: from traffic diversions and working hours to fencing, signage and a complaints procedure.

maintenance.title: A building that can be maintained safely
maintenance.desc: Fill in the building details, go through the safe maintenance checklist and keep track of fixed facilities such as anchor points and roof edge protection, with their last and next inspection. The basis is Article 6.53 of the Dutch Buildings Decree (Bouwbesluit) and Article 2.30 of the Arbobesluit.

vg.title: Health and safety plan
vg.desc: All parts of Article 2.28 of the Arbobesluit, from project details to emergency procedures.

parties.title: Parties involved
parties.desc: The client, the health and safety coordinators for design and execution, and the contractors.

substances.title: Asbestos and hazardous substances
substances.desc: A reference to the asbestos inventory, and for each substance the risk, the measure and whether a safety data sheet is available.

emergency.title: Emergency procedures
emergency.desc: The emergency response team, the first aid post, the evacuation route, the assembly point and the emergency number.

blvc.title: BLVC plan
blvc.desc: Accessibility, liveability, safety and communication, per phase of the project.

maintenance.title: Safe maintenance
maintenance.desc: A ten-point checklist and a list of fixed facilities with their status and inspection dates.

legal.title: The legal basis in view
legal.desc: Each part shows which article applies and when a plan is mandatory.

templates.title: Ten sector templates
templates.desc: From housing and high-rise to demolition, civil works, hydraulic engineering, installation work and foundation work.

modules.title: Twenty risk modules
modules.desc: Together 37 risks with 124 measures, from falls from height to confined spaces and lifting.

matrix.title: A 5 × 5 risk matrix
matrix.desc: Probability times severity gives a score and a level from very low to very high.

hierarchy.title: Measures in the right order
hierarchy.desc: Following the occupational hygiene strategy: the source first, then technical and organisational measures, personal protective equipment last.

categories.title: Eighteen categories
categories.desc: From falls and electricity to asbestos, noise, excavation, drowning and weather conditions.

report.title: The health and safety plan as a report
report.desc: A formatted document with references to Articles 2.26 to 2.31 of the Arbobesluit.

preview.title: Preview with zoom
preview.desc: View the report in the app first, or open it in a window of its own.

print.title: Print or PDF
print.desc: Print the report or save it as a PDF through the print function.

browser.title: In the browser
browser.desc: Nothing to install: open the app and start.

lang.title: Dutch and English
lang.desc: The interface follows the language of your system, or you choose.

themes.title: Light and dark
themes.desc: A light theme and a dark theme in the OpenAEC house style.

ifc.title: IFC in preparation
ifc.desc: A schema to record health and safety data in IFC is ready; a 3D viewer will follow.

whatsnew.label: Latest developments
whatsnew.title: Templates, a report and an address of its own
whatsnew.desc: There is no release yet. This was added in spring 2026.

templates.title: Templates per sector
templates.desc: Ten templates and twenty risk modules, so a health and safety plan no longer starts empty.

report.title: Health and safety plan report
report.desc: A preview in the app, to print or save as a PDF.

ifc.title: IFC schema
ifc.desc: Property sets to exchange risks and measures in an IFC model.

live.title: Try it online
live.desc: The app is available at open-safety-studio.open-aec.com.

status.q: Can I use Open Safety Studio yet?
status.a: You can try it in the browser. It is still in development: saving and reopening projects is not possible yet, and there is no release.

cost.a: Nothing. You use the app for free and without an account.

when.q: When is a health and safety plan mandatory?
when.a: Under the Arbobesluit, among other things when special risks from Annex II apply, when the work takes more than thirty working days with more than twenty people at the same time, or when it takes more than five hundred person-days. The app shows this next to the plan.

law.a: The Dutch ones: Articles 2.26 to 2.31 of the Arbobesluit for the health and safety plan, and Article 6.53 of the Bouwbesluit for safe maintenance. Always check the current regulations for your own project.

templates.a: Choose a template for your type of project, such as renovation of occupied homes or foundation work. The template sets up the matching risk modules, with risks and measures that you then adapt to your project.

lang.q: What language is the app in?
lang.a: The interface is in Dutch and English. The plans themselves follow Dutch regulations.

source.a: Not publicly yet. You can use the app itself for free, and share ideas and problems with the feedback button.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: Built on the shared foundation of the OpenAEC apps, with the same ribbon, panels and themes.

react.title: React and TypeScript
react.desc: The interface with a ribbon, side panels and a status bar.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: The same app can also be built as a desktop app.

i18n.title: react-i18next
i18n.desc: Translations in Dutch and English, ready to be extended with other languages.
